proposal.status: proposal only; API and intentional divergences require integrator approval
proposal.architecture: Core-only Base header/reducer plus separate styled Button wrapper
proposal.selection: caller-owned bool array; requests borrowed synchronous ordered index array; callback accepts by updating values or rejects by preserving them
proposal.scratch: caller-owned request and event scratch; bounded; nonoverlapping; no heap
proposal.stable_ids: nonzero group/child IDs unique; reordered items keep ID but callback index reflects current collection
proposal.overrides: explicit presence flags for size/design-size/variant; compact and outline enable only; density theme-owned
proposal.background_click: group ID, SIZE_MAX child index, unchanged selection; no background Tab stop
proposal.callback_ownership: group handler replaces child handlers when installed; otherwise child handlers survive
proposal.disabled_divergence: group disabled OR child disabled/loading regardless of construction order
proposal.multi_event_policy: input-order requests based on current model after prior callback accept/reject
proposal.paint_order: register all behavior, deliver ordered accepted callbacks, paint final model; same-frame checked/value coherence
proposal.geometry: reuse Button painter with source per-corner/per-edge composition; do not substitute Toggle paint
proposal.remaining_style_limit: group wrapper cannot close underlying Button generic custom style/gradient gaps
proposal.background_click_divergence: Always unchanged selection for an actual background event; do not reuse source render-local stale child index

separate_multiplicity_gap.evidence: prior button completion audit two queued clicks: 2 generated activations, 1 styled callback
cause: src/core/cui.c cui_interact folds accepted slots into bool
src/components/cui_components.c cui_button_ex invokes on_click once for bool
separate_multiplicity_gap.proposed_count_seam: append accepted activation_count to cui_interaction; retain activated any-count Boolean
separate_multiplicity_gap.proposed_event_seam: cui_event_accepted_activation during frame after registration, zero for pending/rejected/cancelled/unsubmitted targets
separate_multiplicity_gap.callback_semantics: one callback per accepted activation, input order; no raw UP counting or child/group duplicates
separate_multiplicity_gap.snapshot_semantics: callbacks do not retroactively invalidate other activations accepted against current submitted inputs
